intro.lead: CopilotWatchTower collects Microsoft 365 Copilot activity from multiple sources and analyzes it in one place. Each collection menu differs in
intro.tail: . Review the characteristics of each source below, then run individual collection from the left menu.

bootstrap.text: — One time only. Creates the Entra app registration and grants the required permissions through tenant administrator consent.

appOnly.text: — Day-to-day collection. Calls the Graph API with the issued secret (valid for 180 days). Some eDiscovery, Teams, and credit paths use delegated / web automation sign-in.

insufficient.suffix: lets you re-consent to the missing permissions, or create a new profile to regenerate the app with the latest permissions.

conversationApi.title: Collect conversations (API)
conversationApi.summary: Collect Copilot conversation message bodies per user directly via the Microsoft Graph API.
conversationApi.technology: Microsoft Graph (beta) · getAllEnterpriseInteractions · app-only (client credentials) token
data: App source (BizChat, Word, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Loop, etc.)
Attachment, link, and mention metadata; raw JSON
constraints: Targets only users with a Copilot license (all / licensed / group / specific users, depending on scope settings)
beta endpoint · paging per user and period (@odata.nextLink)
Message bodies of unlicensed users are collected separately via the eDiscovery path

ediscovery.title: Collect conversations (e-Discovery)
ediscovery.summary: Recover Copilot message bodies via Purview eDiscovery, including unlicensed users.
data: Copilot conversation bodies, including unlicensed users
Messages recovered from case, search, and export artifacts
permissions: Requires the eDiscovery Manager role on the run account
constraints: App-only authentication is Premium-only, so delegated authentication is used
Proceeds through asynchronous stages: case creation → search → estimate → export → download → interpretation
Supports per-stage resume — can restart after an interruption

transcripts.title: Collect conversations (Teams)
transcripts.summary: Collect Teams conversation transcripts of Copilot Studio custom agents from Dataverse.
transcripts.technology: Dataverse automatic sign-in (web automation) · transcript table
data: Teams conversation history (transcripts) of Copilot Studio custom agents
Conversation sessions per agent and environment
permissions: Dataverse access per environment (system administrator permission)
constraints: Requires per-environment access — environments you lack are handled with the 'Automatically add me as system administrator' option
Because it relies on browser automatic sign-in, it is subject to MFA and session policies

agents.title: Agents
agents.summary: Collect agent inventory and real usage signals from the Copilot admin API and audit logs.
agents.technology: Microsoft Graph Copilot admin API (agent registration & catalog) + audit logs
data: Real usage signals based on audit logs
constraints: Usage signals are based on audit logs, so the earlier you collect audit events, the more accurate they are
Some items may be empty depending on admin API availability (tenant configuration)

consumption.title: Power Platform credits
consumption.summary: Download PPAC consumption reports to track message, AI Builder, and API request usage.
consumption.technology: Power Platform admin center (PPAC) automatic sign-in · consumption report download
constraints: Web automation based — depends on PPAC UI/report availability
Collected only within the aggregation periods and units the report provides

audit.title: Audit events
audit.summary: Collect security and access events from the Purview unified audit log and Entra audit/sign-in.
audit.technology: Graph security.auditLog.queries (asynchronous Purview unified log) + Entra audit/sign-in
data: Access and policy related audit events
permissions: Additionally requires the Purview/Exchange roleManagement role
constraints: Only data within the Purview audit log retention period can be queried
Unified log queries are asynchronous (submit → poll → result)
On a 404 response to the auditLog query, the Purview path is disabled automatically and only the Entra path is used

usage.title: Official usage
usage.summary: Collect snapshots of the official Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report.
usage.technology: Microsoft Graph Reports API (Copilot usage CSV)
data: Official Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report snapshots
constraints: Affected by the anonymization setting of Microsoft reports — for user identification, de-anonymize via ReportSettings
Collected only by the reporting period units Microsoft provides
